title: SoilSampledObject
description: The location or parcel from which a soil sample was collected.

id.description: Application record ID stored in the payload; distinct from the containing MetaEnvelope ID.

bundle_id.description: Application payload ID reference, not a MetaEnvelope ID. See the soil import model documentation.

soil_sample_id.description: Application payload ID reference, not a MetaEnvelope ID. See the soil import model documentation.

field_w3id.description: MetaEnvelope ID of the linked crop field in the owner eVault, not an external provider ID. Omit this property when unlinked.
